name: en_reopen_mid_interview
description: Reactive queue: the vague-wording finding was resolved before the interview and is reopened after the first answer (it must be asked); the error-handling finding is resolved in the document after the second answer (it must not be asked any more).
requirements:
REQ-1: The user can request a password reset by entering their email address.
REQ-2: The reset page should load fast.
REQ-3: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.
REQ-4: The new password must be at least 12 characters long.

issues.note: what the user sees after requesting a reset

rule.contradiction.REQ-3+REQ-4.value: REQ-4: The new password must be at least 12 characters long.

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-1.value: A message says that a reset link was sent.

rule.ambiguous_wording.REQ-2.value: The page is interactive within 2 seconds.
